candidate_workaround: Read or regenerate the exact manifest structure from measured current Git-blob hashes rather than guessed context.
failure_signature: An apply-patch request guesses stale generated-manifest bytes and hash context and is rejected without mutation.
recurrence_guard: Never patch generated manifest entries against inferred bytes or hash context.
rollback: Retain the rejected patch with zero credit; it changed no file and requires no content rollback.
scope_boundary: Post-pass owner-scoped receipt and Git-blob accounting only; tests and privacy scans are not rerun.
title: Regenerate final manifest entries from measured Git blobs
trigger_preconditions: A post-pass result receipt must be added and the generated final manifest requires an exact refresh.
